schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE categorie_prodotti (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    nome TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    descrizione TEXT,
    deleted_at TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE fornitori (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    ragione_sociale TEXT NOT NULL,
    partita_iva TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    citta TEXT,
    email TEXT,
    deleted_at TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE prodotti (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    codice TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    nome TEXT NOT NULL,
    categoria_id BIGINT REFERENCES categorie_prodotti(id),
    fornitore_id BIGINT REFERENCES fornitori(id),
    prezzo_unitario NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (prezzo_unitario >= 0),
    costo_acquisto NUMERIC(10,2) CHECK (costo_acquisto >= 0),
    giacenza INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (giacenza >= 0),
    deleted_at TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE clienti (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    nome TEXT NOT NULL,
    cognome TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT UNIQUE,
    citta TEXT,
    deleted_at TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE ordini_vendita (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    numero_ordine TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    cliente_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES clienti(id),
    data_ordine DATE NOT NULL,
    stato_ordine TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (stato_ordine IN ('bozza', 'confermato', 'spedito', 'fatturato', 'annullato')),
    deleted_at TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE righe_ordini (
    id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    ordine_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES ordini_vendita(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    prodotto_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES prodotti(id),
    quantita INT NOT NULL CHECK (quantita > 0),
    prezzo_unitario NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (prezzo_unitario >= 0),
    sconto_percentuale NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (sconto_percentuale BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
    deleted_at TIMESTAMP
);
